name: crowd-probe-a2
delta:
SEED ROLES. The FIRST image is the crowd exemplar — use its anonymous crowd proportion, face tier and the bounded 2-3 flat head-tone set it repeats; take nothing of its dress, period or setting, which each scene authors for itself.

Behind the same brass rail, a restrained shopper crowd in plain 1980s clothing -- every figure on the channel's simple round-head crowd rig, NO historical or Victorian costume, no top hats, no bonnets -- holds toward the few remaining unlabeled PC boxes, their bodies a small midground band beneath a huge skylit retail vault; cobalt, cream, and walnut preserve the world-over-people ratio.
